personality_one_liner: Meet the person you'll build your next company with—a cinematic, glass-layered interface optimized for premium matching.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-like margins. Cards never sit flush to screen edges. Embrace negative space to spotlight high-value content.

do's: Apply expo-blur to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use frosted glass overlays on featured Discovery cards over the background image.
Ensure underlying tint opacity is ≥75% of surface to guarantee text readability.
Use blur for match celebration cinematic reveals.
dont's: Do not blur form fields or standard list rows.
Do not use glass without a translucent tinted base underneath.
Do not stack more than two glass surfaces per screen.

screens.name: Welcome/Splash
screens.purpose: Establish premium identity with cinematic lighting and a clear entry point.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract dark geometric background. Large display typography at the top, primary CTA anchored at the bottom thumb zone with a glass backdrop.

screens.name: Auth (Login/Register)
screens.purpose: Minimal friction entry with high perceived trust.
screens.layout: Single column. Large inputs with labels above. surfaceTertiary background for inputs. Sticky CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Multi-step Onboarding
screens.purpose: Collect nuanced professional data while maintaining high engagement.
screens.layout: Persistent progress bar at the top edge. Each step features a large headline (xl/2xl), generous vertical rhythm, and oversized pill-shaped selectable options. Bottom sticky CTA.

screens.name: Discovery/Swipe
screens.purpose: Evaluate potential co-founders through a rich, data-driven card stack.

states.empty: Dark atmospheric illustration indicating no more profiles.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button centered on screen.

screens.layout: Hero screen. Full-bleed vertical image cards (safe-area respected) with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom, ≥70% surfaceInverse at bottom). Professional stats overlay the bottom 30%.

screens.name: Match Celebration
screens.purpose: Deliver a cinematic, dopamine-inducing moment when mutual interest occurs.
screens.layout: Full screen overlay using heavy glassmorphism. Split-screen profile photos merging, elegant typography ('It\'s a Match'), and a brandPrimary CTA to start chatting.

screens.name: Matches List & Chat
screens.purpose: Superhuman-fast list of conversations and an iMessage-quality chat thread.

states.empty: Tinted icon container with 'No conversations yet'.

screens.layout: List: Clean rows, minimum 56pt height, large circular avatars, truncated preview. Chat: High-contrast bubbles, surfaceTertiary for recipient, brandSecondary for sender. Sticky input field.

screens.name: Deal Room
screens.purpose: Provide a collaborative space for matched founders to iterate on ideas.
screens.layout: Tabbed structure (Tasks, Roadmap, Docs). Card-based grid with soft shadows. Prominent FAB (brandPrimary) for adding new items.

screens.name: AI Assistant Chat
screens.purpose: Consult Claude for business guidance in a sleek, command-driven interface.
screens.layout: Message thread with distinct styling for the AI (maybe a subtle brandTertiary background). Bottom pinned input with a premium blur backdrop.

screens.name: Projects Board
screens.purpose: Browse opportunities through structured, scannable data.
screens.layout: Multi-column grid or wide single-column cards. Pinned filter row (glass) below the header. Each card displays tags (surfaceTertiary) and key metrics.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase user's professional gamification and stats.
screens.layout: Hero image/banner with a dark gradient overlay. Profile avatar overlapping the header. Stats displayed in a 2-col or 3-col grid with large numeric typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '6 Glass / Luxe' DARK personality. Use the #09090B to #27272A slate spectrum for backgrounds and cards to avoid pure black fatigue.
BANNED: Any trace of blue, purple, or indigo. Stick to the defined brand palette (Antique Gold / #D4AF37) for all primary accents and highlights.
Typography must be Geist for both display and body. Use weight to establish hierarchy but never exceed 500. Use sizing (xl, 2xl) to create contrast.

Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern strictly on the Discovery/Swipe hero cards. Text over images must sit in the bottom 30-40% over a 3-stop vertical gradient reaching ≥70% surfaceInverse opacity.
Include haptic feedback strictly mapped in the 'haptics' block (swipe events, match celebration, tab switches).
For the Chat UI, imitate the spacing and bubble contrast of iMessage but adapt it to our dark palette (surfaceTertiary vs brandSecondary).
For empty states, utilize the fetched images layered with a subtle brandTertiary tint and blur to create a rich, non-clinical environment.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system UI. Use lucide-react-native consistently.
